name: Papenburg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Papenburg (a black lion on red under a crown).
history: Municipal flag of Papenburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Papenburg arms — black lion on red with crown
